restaurantName: Khao Lam Mae Khai Toon Klao
address: 357 Sukhumvit Road, Saen Suk, Mueang Chon Buri, Chon Buri, 20130, Thailand
bio: For over 60 years, this dessert stall has served classic sweetened sticky rice in the traditional way – cooked in bamboo with fresh coconut milk. Choose from original white or aromatic black sticky rice, garnished with taro, black beans, or ginkgo nuts; available in three portion sizes....
